description: Unique document ID, format D followed by 5 digits (D00001...). Primary key.
Name/code of the publisher or origin of the document (20 sources: Source_1 to Source_20).
Topic category of the document: Business, Science, Politics, Technology, Sports, Health, Entertainment.
Total number of words in the document (document length). Range in data: 107 to 2000.
Average number of words per sentence in the document. Range in data: 10.0 to 30.0.
Number of distinct words in the document. Must be <= word_count.
Readability score of the document (higher = easier to read). Range in data: 30.0 to 79.9.
